scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:cli && bun run build:desktop
scripts.build:packages: bun build packages/core/src/index.ts packages/platform/src/index.ts packages/protocol/src/index.ts --outdir dist/packages --target bun
scripts.build:desktop: bun node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs prepare && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build && bun node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs build --env=stable
scripts.dev: bun node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs prepare && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build && bun node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs dev --watch
